# QS-CFW-6160-72 — Quality specification - crankshaft blank CFW-6160-72 (4340)
Revision: Rev E  
This revision supersedes Rev D.  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-6160-72

Scope
This specification defines quality acceptance criteria and inspection method for crankshaft blank CFW-6160-72 (CFW-6160-72) manufactured from 4340 material at Plant P1. It applies to production forgings and controlled subcontract forgings intended to be delivered as crankshaft blank CFW-6160-72.

Requirements table

| Characteristic | Specification | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | 4340 | See forging traveler for melt traceability |
| Hardness (quenched/tempered) | 26-31 HRC | Measure on machined reference flat |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.07 mm | Apply to finished bore prior to final inspection |
| Maximum forging weight | 22.9 kg | Weigh as-received forging; trim and gating excluded from weight declaration |
| Surface condition | Free of through-thickness laps and scale adhering beyond standard grind allowance | Visual and surface roughness control per plant practice |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Perform Rockwell hardness testing on representative surfaces of crankshaft blank CFW-6160-72 using calibrated equipment. Record individual readings and report compliance to the hardness requirement 26-31 HRC.
- Dimensional: Measure bore diameter and verify tolerance ±0.07 mm. Use calibrated bore gauge appropriate for the feature and document measured value against the tolerance.
- Weight: Verify maximum forging weight by weighing the as-forged part labeled CFW-6160-72 and compare to 22.9 kg.
- Visual: Inspect for forging defects, laps, and scale. Any feature suspect for discontinuity requires follow-up nondestructive examination per plant NDE practice.

Nonconformance handling
Nonconforming crankshaft blank CFW-6160-72 shall be segregated and tagged. Initiate containment and root-cause actions per plant quality system. Disposition options include rework where defect is within permissible grind allowance, heat treat rework where metallurgical condition can be corrected, or rejection and scrap where restoration is not feasible. All dispositions must be documented in the quality record for the affected CFW-6160-72 part.
